bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to child care; appropriating money for child care improvement grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; CHILD CARE IMPROVEMENT GRANTS.

$2,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for child care improvement grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 142D.20, subdivision 3, paragraph (a), clause (7). Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.98, subdivision 14, the amount for administrative costs under these appropriations is $0.
additions: $2,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for child care improvement grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 142D.20, subdivision 3, paragraph (a), clause (7). Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.98, subdivision 14, the amount for administrative costs under these appropriations is $0.
